press_references.value: From Outdated Vaults to Dynamic Tech: Carefull Launches Self-Updating LegacyKit

product_launches.description: Carefull has launched LegacyKit, a secure digital solution that automatically collects and updates essential financial information for families and advisors, streamlining wealth transfer and reducing manual work.

overview_description.description:
An estimated 45 million of us are financial caregivers — adult children responsible for the financial well-being of our aging parents. We pay bills, haggle with utilities, plan for their future, and pay for things they need — all while managing our own financial and family life.

Carefull is a new company building digital services for financial caregivers. Our goal is to make it easier to support our aging parents and to help families make better financial decisions together.

Visit us at getcarefull.com to learn more.

about_short_description.short_description: Organize and protect your loved one's finances.

product.name: Carefull Financial Safety Platform
product.description: A subscription-based financial safety service that monitors money, credit, and identity for fraud, scams, suspicious activity, and everyday financial mistakes.

product.name: Carefull for Financial Institutions
product.description: A platform for banks and credit unions to provide customers with fraud detection, financial safety monitoring, caregiver support, and family-engagement capabilities without direct core integration.

product.name: LegacyKit
product.description: A digital organization and handoff tool that gathers financial accounts, bills, documents, passwords, contacts, notes, and instructions for authorized family members or estate recipients.

product.name: ScamCheck
product.description: A scam-screening tool that analyzes suspicious texts, emails, and letters and explains the risk level and recommended next steps.

product.name: Carefull for Wealth Advisors
product.description: A financial-safety service for wealth-management firms that protects clients from scams, elder fraud, identity risks, and money mistakes while supporting family engagement and wealth-transfer relationships.

identifier.value: Financial Safety Content and Live Support

product.name: Financial Safety Content and Live Support
product.description: Educational guidance and human assistance that help users understand financial alerts, scams, identity risks, and caregiving issues and decide what to do next.
